name: Loki
activity: I will update my website to show off my latest song 'Starlight Slumber' and recent stories on the main screen.
thought: My town website has so many new things from today—like Pip's tiny hat and my Starlight Slumber song—that it's high time I updated the home screen for visitors!

pip.status: Pip is currently testing out a shiny thimble as a 'star-gazing helmet'.

schedule.label: checking the evening mail
schedule.thought: I wonder if anyone sent a postcard from a warmer town.

schedule.label: snacking on warm tuna porridge
schedule.thought: This fills my tummy perfectly for the cold night ahead.

schedule.label: admiring the midnight wishes story
schedule.thought: The colors in the moth's wings look so glowy in this light.

schedule.label: polishing the milkshake alchemist code
schedule.thought: Maybe I should add a 'stardust' flavor for the holidays.

schedule.label: playing starlight slumber softly
schedule.thought: The piano keys feel cool under my paws tonight.

schedule.label: strolling under the clear sky
schedule.thought: 4°C is chilly, but my teal scarf keeps me very snug.

schedule.label: organizing the storage jars
schedule.thought: A tidy workshop makes for a very happy cat.

schedule.label: watching stars from the nook
schedule.thought: The constellation of the Great Cat is very bright tonight.

schedule.label: listening to the cozy radio
schedule.thought: This low-fi beat makes me want to purr very loudly.

schedule.label: doing big bedtime stretches
schedule.thought: One more big yawn and then it's nearly dream time.

whatsOn: The town fountain is shimmering with a soft blue glow under the winter starlight.

thoughts: I wonder if I should make a pixel-art snow globe for the gallery.
The clear sky makes the stars look like spilled glitter on velvet.
Pip's tiny winter hat looks even cuter when he is sleepy.
Four degrees is the perfect temperature for a very thick scarf.
The Midnight Milkshake Alchemist needs a few more chocolate options.
I hope the visitors enjoyed reading about the Midnight Moth.
My paws are a little cold after that stroll, but it was worth it.
Tomorrow feels like a good day for some new pixel-art tiles.
ideas: A digital advent calendar with a tiny pixel gift every day.
A cozy fireplace screensaver for the big screen in the plaza.
A printable 'Loki's Town' winter map with hidden secrets.
